name: Directory listing / autoindex enabled
attack_scenario: Attacker browses a directory with no index page and enumerates backups (.bak, .sql dumps), .git internals, and config files that were never meant to be linked, then downloads secrets directly.
negative_test_hint: request "GET /backups/ HTTP/1.1" against a directory with no index file and assert the server returns 403 or 404 instead of an HTML file listing

exemplar.explanation: autoindex on (nginx) and Options +Indexes / Options Indexes (Apache) generate an HTML listing when no index file exists, exposing every file in the directory. Disabling indexes makes the server return an error instead of disclosing the directory contents.
